标题: Acute viral respiratory infections in children before and during the COVID-19 pandemic in a Peruvian reference hospital.
摘要: （规则抽取，未使用大模型）Our objective was to evaluate the frequency and characteristics of acute respiratory infections (ARI) with confirmed viral etiology in children treated at a Peruvian referral hospital before and during the COVID-19 pandemic between 2019 and 2022. We conducted a descriptive study based on the detection records of adenovirus, influenza A and B (IA and IB), parainfluenza 1-3 (PIV), metapneumovirus (hMPV), and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). Of 1740 episodes (1220 patients), 14.4% tested positive: 196 (78.0%) RSV, 23 (9.2%) IA, 14 (5.6%) PIV-3, and 13 (5.2%) hMPV.

宿主: human
地区: Peru
